findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.comment: Inspector observed raw shelled eggs stored over ready to eat foods (including but not limited to heavy whipping cream and prepared cakes). CORRECTED- the shelled eggs were moved below the ready to eat items. Ensure raw product is always stored below ready to eat product to prevent cross contamination of foods.
findings.citation_text: 3-302.11(A)(1) Packaged and Unpackaged Food - Separation, Packaging, and Segregation. (A) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by: (1) Except as specified in (1)(d) below or when combined as ingredients, separating raw animal FOODS during storage, preparation, holding, and display from: (a) Raw READY-TO-EAT FOOD including other raw animal FOOD such as FISH for sushi or MOLLUSCAN SHELLFISH, or other raw READY-TOEAT FOOD such as fruits and vegetables, (b) Cooked READY-TO-EAT FOOD, and (c) Fruits and vegetables before they are washed; (d) Frozen, commercially processed and packaged raw animal FOOD may be stored or displayed with or above frozen, commercially processed and packaged, ready-to-eat food. [P]

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored and used.
findings.comment: Inspector observed the sanitizer bucket to contain a concentration higher than was able to be registered by the facility’s test strips. CORRECTED- the sanitizer was remade to 200 ppm quaternary ammonia. Ensure sanitizers used for foods contact surfaces are made and tested at a frequency to ensure the concentration as recommended by the manufacturer's label (200-400 ppm quaternary ammonia).
findings.citation_text: 7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria. Chemical SANITIZERS, including chemical sanitizing solutions generated on-site, and other chemical antimicrobials applied to FOOD-CONTACT SURFACEs shall: (A) Meet the requirements specified in 40 CFR 180.940 Tolerance exemptions for active and inert ingredients for use in antimicrobial formulations (Food-contact surface sanitizing solutions), or (B) Meet the requirements as specified in 40 CFR 180.2020 Pesticide Chemicals Not Requiring a Tolerance or Exemption from Tolerance-Nonfood determinations.[P]

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspector observed the baffles of the ice machine to contain a small accumulation of soil debris. CORRECTED- person in charge (PIC) wiped the ice baffles cleaned, and stated they are cleaned on a weekly basis. Ensure all food contact surfaces are maintained clean to sight and touch. The frequency of cleaning may need adjusted with increased use and temperatures outside.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. [Pf]

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Inspector observed the top of the microwave’s interior to contain an accumulation of food debris. CORRECTED- the PIC was informed of the accumulation and wiped the area with a clean sanitizer cloth. Ensure nonfood contact surfaces are cleaned at a frequency to prevent the accumulation or food debris, or other materials that may contaminate ready to eat (RTE) foods.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris. [C]

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.comment:
Signed reporting agreements are not on file for any employees. Inspector emailed a blank reporting agreement. Print copies and review with all employees. Keep signed agreements on file for review during health inspections.
2-103.11: (O) FOOD EMPLOYEES are informed in verifiable manner of their responsibility to report accordance with LAW, to PIC, information about their health related to disease transmissible through FOOD. [Pf]

findings.title: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events
findings.comment:
Facility does not have a vomit/diarrhea clean up policy on file. Inspector emailed a clean up policy to the PIC. Print the vomit/diarrhea clean up policy and keep it on file for reference in case clean up is needed.
2-501.11: A FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall have written procedures for EMPLOYEES to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the FOOD ESTABLISHMENT. The procedures shall address the specific actions EMPLOYEES must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of EMPLOYEES, consumers, FOOD, and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. [Pf]

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment:
A container of almondmilk was observed with no in-house open date, and a manufacturer expiration date of 4/20. CORRECTED- PIC voluntarily discarded the almondmilk. Ensure that products are labeled with the date they were opened if they will remain in the facility for over 24 hours.
3-501.18: (A) FOOD shall be discarded if exceeding temperature and time criteria. If container or PACKAGE does not bear a date or day or if inappropriately marked with date or day exceeding temperature and time combination. (B) Refrigerated RTE TCS FOOD prepared in FOOD ESTABLISHMENT and dispensed through vending machine shall be discarded if exceeding temperature and time. [P]
3-501.17: (A) Except for ROP, Refrigerated, RTE, TCS Food prepared and held in a food establishment for more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked to indicate the date/maximum of 7 days. Day of preparation is Day 1. (B) Date marking may not exceed manufacturer’s use-by date. (C) Combined portions of food shall retain the date marking of the earliest-prepared food. [Pf]

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used
findings.comment:
Employee jackets were observed stored hanging on the dry storage shelves. Designate an area and consider putting up hooks for employee item storage so jackets are not stored directly on food/single service item packaging.
6-403.11: (B) Lockers or other suitable facilities shall be located in a designated room or area where contamination of FOOD, EQUIPMENT, UTENSILS, LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES cannot occur. [C]

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
Raw shell eggs observed stored above RTE foods, including pastries. CORRECTED- PIC rearranged storage to prevent potential cross contamination. Ensure raw eggs are stored below ready-to-eat foods.
3-302.11: (A) (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display. [P]

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Sanitizer bucket observed at 100ppm quat. CORRECTED- PIC remade sanitizer bucket to correct concentration. 
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (C) Quaternary ammonium shall have a concentration of 200-400ppm. [P]

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment:
Open, nearly-empty gallon of milk observed without date-marking. CORRECTED- Discussed with PIC. Ensure refrigerated, TCS foods are labeled with the date they were opened or prepared.
3-501.17: (A) Except for ROP, Refrigerated, RTE, TCS Food prepared and held in a food establishment for more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked to indicate the date/maximum of 7 days. Day of preparation is Day 1. [Pf]

findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.comment:
Boxes of single service cups observed stored on the floor in the dry storage area. Ensure food, clean equipment, and single service items are stored at least 6 inches above the floor.
4-903.11: (A) clean EQUIPMENT and clean ARTICLES shall be stored in clean, dry location where they are not exposed to contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. (C) SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be kept in original PACKAGE or stored in manner to protect it against contamination. [C]

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used
findings.comment:
Employee foods observed stored intermixed with items for service in the coolers and on shelving in the baking area. Ensure personal items are stored below and away from foods and equipment used for service. 
6-501.110: (B) Lockers or other suitable facilities shall be used for the orderly storage of EMPLOYEE clothing and other possessions. [C]
